status: frozen before any recovery fits; all data already exposed
population: 1600 exposed recovery puzzles; fitting/evaluation restricted to 1010 independently verified original failures; original successes always retained
targets: Separate binary target per action: saved potential retry independently verifies valid given original failure; one identity-seeded attempt estimates recoverability for this procedure, not intrinsic rescue probability

features.decoded_confidence: Exactly 8 sorted current level-6 decoded diagnostics plus 6 level-6 generator confidence summaries, replay-checked against prefix/current board
features.combined: 14 decoded_confidence + 5 input + prefix code entropy and unique fraction (21 total)

folds.assignment: Sort unique group IDs by SHA256(study_id:group); round robin; same fold for every record/action of a group; no outcome stratification
folds.preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on training failures only inside each fold; no imputation (reject nonfinite values)
folds.selection: No tuning, repeated CV, threshold search or final all-data refit

models.input_logistic: input_only; StandardScaler + LogisticRegression C=0.1, lbfgs, max_iter=1000, no class weighting
models.combined_histogram: SECONDARY; combined; HistGradientBoostingClassifier max_iter=100, max_leaf_nodes=7, min_samples_leaf=30, l2_regularization=10, max_bins=32, learning_rate=0.1, early_stopping=false

controls: verifier-first uniform random expectation and one frozen hash order
allocation: After final verification, rank only failures within their OOF fold, allocate exact total budget proportionally to fold failure counts with largest-remainder quotas; identity hash breaks ties. Avoid comparing uncalibrated scores across fitted folds. Same quotas for every control. Existing original confidence-alert 9/21 results reproduced separately (alerts included successes).
metrics: gain in original-cohort accuracy percentage points
AUROC and average precision among original failures

uncertainty.method: Paired group percentile bootstrap of fixed OOF policy contributions; recompute selected count and uniform expectation in each draw. Report 95% intervals; primary two-action comparisons additionally use 97.5% intervals. No model refits; conditional on fitted scores and selected masks, omits training/selection instability and seed variability. Not confirmation or adjusted evidence for selecting the best secondary model/control.

cost: Reuse saved synchronized timing only. At each action/budget envelope N*monitored_mean + M*max_observed_retry_ms. Feature policies conservatively charged full monitor on all N=1600; verifier-first and input-only policies pay N*plain_mean, receiving extra slots from avoided monitoring. Report equal-count and service-matched expectations/realizations, timing-pair bootstrap sensitivity and break-even additional scorer milliseconds per puzzle. Old profile does not measure new scorer; no new generation/timing experiment. Maximum retry latency is an observed replay envelope, not a guarantee.
decision: Support proposing a future independent study only if PRIMARY combined_logistic yields >=8 additional rescues (0.5pp/1600) over expected random at 272, positive two-action 97.5% lower interval, positive service-cost advantage and beats all cheap/failure-score controls in count rescues for that action. Otherwise reject advancement under this protocol if primary upper interval excludes 8-rescue gain; else inconclusive/no-go pending fresh design. Secondary-only promise cannot pass this gate. This is an exploratory triage rule, not reopening earlier gates.
phases: 2 implement leakage-safe evaluation and tests, before real fitting; commit/push
3 one bounded analysis, report decision/resources/limits; commit/push and open PR
preservation: Read original artifacts in source checkout; hash before and after; never modify consumed ledgers or historical reports. Separate durable analysis ledger counts attempts before fitting, including failed jobs, refuses repeated run. Unit tests use synthetic data/mocked estimators, zero research fits. No checkpoint loads or generation imports.
